definitions.relevant: The note's content directly supports questions about the case's learning_objective.
definitions.borderline: Same technology and page, adjacent to the objective but not named by it. Excluded from strict precision, included in lenient precision.
definitions.not_relevant: Every other note of the same category (implicit: any id not listed).

provenance: Labels were written after reading each note and each case learning_objective, independently of retriever scores. They were NOT produced by running the retriever. The author is an AI assistant, not a human domain expert, so a human must confirm them. The retriever's objective-bonus rule was tuned earlier on these same six cases (CH-13), so these cases are not an independent test set; no held-out cases exist.
